interpretation_boundary.arrow_meaning: The arrow maps a matched projection-disabled terminal outcome to the projection-enabled terminal outcome for the same training run, represented by the same final checkpoint, and evaluation key.
interpretation_boundary.not_mechanism_proof: The correspondence does not prove deliberate projector reliance, policy-projector co-adaptation, formal safety, or behavior under another projector or arbitrary geometry.
interpretation_boundary.not_temporal: It is not a temporal transition within one trajectory; the two controller executions can diverge after their actions differ.
interpretation_boundary.replication: Training-run-level proportions are summarized across training runs; pooled episode counts describe matched evaluation coverage, not additional training-run replication.

matrix_definition.arrow_direction: projection disabled outcome -> projection enabled outcome
matrix_definition.conditional_proportion_denominator: matched pairs having the reported projection-disabled row outcome; null when that row count is zero
matrix_definition.joint_proportion_denominator: all matched pairs in the reported training run or pooled method group
matrix_definition.timeout_source: validated truncated indicator in the exhaustive success/collision/timeout outcome partition
